notes.title: Small changes of the first day
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, Small changes of the first day

-Changed the speed of the turret movement

-Changed the delay time of the lasers

-Fixed the error with the country toy

-Decreased the number of spiders in the 2nd room

-Optimized the 2nd room

-Fixed some small bugs

-Corrected localization


Thank you to everyone who played, I will be very glad to your feedback, also visit our discord channel

notes.title: Demo version
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, today the demo version is available. I will be interested in your feedback, this is something new, I haven't made horrors and puzzles for a long time, I want another game like this in my portfolio

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824650/PLACE_Demo"][/dynamiclink]
You are a random person trapped in an empty \concrete room\ under the watchful eye of a camera. The only way out is to risk pressing the forbidden button, after which more \buttons\ appear. Each press brings you closer to the exit or to your demise.

If you like this idea, add it to your wishlist and follow the development in my discord channel
